# Unidot humanoid decoder

Vendored unmodified `humanoid/human_trait.gd` and `humanoid/transform_util.gd` from
https://github.com/V-Sekai/unidot_importer at commit
`9719eaa2c5ac10c6444800913a06f28934f4dc34`.

Apache-2.0; copyright Lyuma and contributors, and lox9973. See file headers and LICENSE.
These are used by `../../convert_muscles.gd` with Godot 4.4.1's standard humanoid profile.
They decode Unity muscle curves; they do not establish exact Unity runtime parity for Marycia.
